name: ImageJ.js
description: ImageJ.js imaging and macro automation in an independent App window.

actions.name: status
actions.description: Read connection state and current image identity and dimensions.

actions.name: open
actions.description: Open a sandbox image in this instance and confirm it loaded.

actions.name: run_macro
actions.description: Run an ImageJ macro in this instance and return its result and image state.

params.expected_image_id: optional current image id from desktop_read

actions.name: select_image
actions.description: Select an existing image by its exact title.

notes: Self-contained frontend and supervised image preparation backend. The stable imagej id preserves existing windows and file associations.
